newsitem.title: ITALY: Talks between Italy govt and hardleft "positive".
newsitem.headline: Talks between Italy govt and hardleft "positive".

text.p: Talks between the Communist Refoundation and Italian government are good, Oliviero Diliberto, parliamentary party leader of the hard-left Refoundation, said on Friday after a top level meeting between the two sides.
"The discussions between us and the government were positive," he told reporters, adding that the two sides were working for "compromise" deals.
Deputy prime minister Walter Veltroni, flanked by some government ministers met Refoundation leader Fausto Bertinotti on Thursday night.

Refoundation secures the coalition's majority in the lower house of parliament, but tensions have risen recently with the hard-left party warning that it would not back fresh tax hikes or cuts to social spending in the forthcoming mini-budget.
Diliberto said his party wanted individual agreements with the government on individual issues. "A global accord would damage (us)," he said. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
